description: This file implements video handling functionalities for the Battle for Wesnoth project, including video mode setup, surface management, screen updates, and a test program for rendering.

classes.name: CVideo
classes.description: Class managing video modes, surfaces, and screen updates for the game.

methods.name: CVideo
methods.description: Constructor initializing SDL video subsystem.

methods.name: CVideo
methods.description: Constructor setting specific video mode.

methods.name: ~CVideo
methods.description: Destructor shutting down SDL video subsystem.

methods.name: blit_surface
methods.description: Blits a surface onto the video surface at specified coordinates.

methods.name: make_fake
methods.description: Creates a fake video surface for testing.

methods.name: modePossible
methods.description: Checks if a video mode is possible.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the video mode with specified resolution and flags.

methods.name: modeChanged
methods.description: Checks if the video mode has changed.

methods.name: setGamma
methods.description: Sets the gamma correction.

methods.name: getx
methods.description: Returns the width of the video surface.

methods.name: gety
methods.description: Returns the height of the video surface.

methods.name: getBitsPerPixel
methods.description: Returns bits per pixel of the current video surface.

methods.name: getBytesPerPixel
methods.description: Returns bytes per pixel of the current video surface.

methods.name: getRedMask
methods.description: Returns the red mask of the pixel format.

methods.name: getGreenMask
methods.description: Returns the green mask of the pixel format.

methods.name: getBlueMask
methods.description: Returns the blue mask of the pixel format.

methods.name: flip
methods.description: Updates the display with the current buffer, optimizing for partial updates.

methods.name: lock_updates
methods.description: Locks or unlocks update batching.

methods.name: update_locked
methods.description: Checks if updates are currently locked.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the surface for direct pixel access.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the surface after direct pixel access.

methods.name: mustLock
methods.description: Checks if the surface must be locked before access.

methods.name: getSurface
methods.description: Returns the current video surface.

methods.name: isFullScreen
methods.description: Returns whether the current mode is fullscreen.

methods.name: setBpp
methods.description: Sets bits per pixel for the video mode.

methods.name: getBpp
methods.description: Returns bits per pixel.

methods.name: set_help_string
methods.description: Displays a help string overlay on the screen.

methods.name: clear_help_string
methods.description: Removes the specified help string overlay.

methods.name: clear_all_help_strings
methods.description: Removes all help string overlays.
